article.title: Fiserv為美國Clover商戶加入AI建站與庫存同步
article.summary: Fiserv公布，美國Clover商戶可從基本商戶資料建立網店，並連接現有門店商品和庫存。
highlights: 公司列出搜尋及AI購物曝光設定。
商品、庫存、顧客、訂單和付款可與Clover同步。
article.why: 有門市的小企可先檢查網店與門店是否讀取同一份庫存，避免促銷期間顯示已售罄商品。
article.next_step: 挑幾款暢銷商品，核對庫存更新、訂單狀態及搜尋可見的商品資料。
article.detail: Fiserv稱，Clover的美國商戶可輸入基本資料及創意偏好來建立網店。新功能包括搜尋及AI購物曝光設定，亦可把商品、庫存和訂單與門店Clover系統同步。零售團隊可先測試購買後的庫存更新，並核對搜尋頁看到的商品資料是否與網店一致。亦可核對退款後的庫存變動。
article.title_en: Fiserv adds AI site creation and inventory sync for US Clover merchants
article.summary_en: Fiserv says US Clover merchants can create a store using basic business details and connect their existing products and inventory.
highlights_en: The company describes discovery settings for search and AI shopping.
Products, stock, customers, orders and payments can sync with Clover.
article.why_en: Store operators can check whether online and in-store stock come from the same source to avoid promoting sold-out items.
article.next_step_en: Check stock updates, order status and search-visible product data for a few popular items.
article.detail_en: Fiserv says US Clover merchants can create an online store using basic details and creative preferences. New capabilities include discovery settings for search and AI shopping and sync products, inventory and orders with Clover. Test inventory changes after a purchase and check that the information shown in search matches the store. Check stock changes after a refund as well.
